epic.title: Parent Timetable Module
epic.body: Provides parents with a clear view of their children's weekly and daily schedules, enabling them to monitor academic commitments, teacher assignments, and classroom locations for multiple children.

features.title: Multi-Child Timetable Visibility
features.body: Interface for parents to switch between their children's profiles and view their specific class schedules in both daily and weekly formats.

stories.title: Child-Specific Timetable View
stories.body: As a parent, I want to view the timetable for my selected child so I can know their subjects, teachers, and room numbers for the day.
acceptanceCriteria: List: Display a timeline of class slots for the selected child.
Child Context: Header must display the name of the child (e.g., 'Aarav Kumar') whose timetable is being viewed.
Details: Each slot must show the Time, Subject, Teacher Name, and Room/Lab number.
Visual Cues: Use color-coding to distinguish between regular academic periods and 'BREAK' slots.
Navigation: Include a back button to return to the Parent Dashboard.

stories.title: Daily & Weekly View Toggling
stories.body: As a parent, I want to switch between a detailed daily view and a broad weekly overview of my child's schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggle: Provide 'Daily' and 'Weekly' buttons to switch view modes.
Weekly Grid: In weekly mode, show a scrollable or grid-based layout representing all school days (Monday-Saturday).
Date Navigation: Allow parents to move between dates using 'Previous' and 'Next' chevron buttons.

stories.title: Parent-Scoped Timetable Retrieval (Read)
stories.body: API endpoints to serve timetable data specifically for the children linked to the authenticated parent's account.
acceptanceCriteria: List: GET endpoint to fetch timetable records for a specific childId.
Security: Ensure the parent is authorized to view the requested child's data based on the parent-child mapping.
Metadata: Serve period IDs, subject names, teacher names, and room locations as a structured JSON array.

features.title: Dashboard Timetable Integration
features.body: Quick-access entry points from the main parent dashboard to the timetable module based on the currently selected child.

stories.title: Dashboard to Timetable Navigation
stories.body: As a parent, I want to click a 'Timetable' action on my dashboard to see the schedule for my currently active child profile.
acceptanceCriteria: Action Link: Implement a 'Timetable' quick-action button on the Parent Dashboard.
Context Passing: Clicking the action must navigate to the timetable screen with the `childName` and `mode='parent'` props correctly set.
